title: Item document — items/{id}.json
description: §5 (all kinds) and §9 (withdrawal endcap). Ground truth for one item. Required members are those the spec's MUST clauses depend on; the spec gives no explicit required-member list (see README, For Fable).

blyg.description: §3.1: the spec version the publisher implements; informative, readers accept any 0.x (decision #18d).

id.description: §5.1: permanent identity, never changes across versions or withdrawal (decision #2).

kind.description: §5.3: fragment | thread | withdrawn at 0.3. Readers treat unknown kinds as unknown constructs; a 0.3 publisher emits only these.

origin.description: §5 / §15.4: the publisher's identity origin; mention verification requires it to equal the source URL's origin (decision #28).

page.description: §5.8 (decision #29): origin-relative permalink (absolute permitted by #51 at 0.4). SHOULD be stable for the life of the item (decision #56). Kept on withdrawn endcaps (§9).

updated.description: §5.2: MUST equal the latest changelog entry's `at` (semantic rule updated.equals-last-changelog).

content_md.description: §5: markdown source of the latest version; keeps directives (§10.2); never TK grammar (§5.7, decision #20).

content_html.description: §5.2 (decision #53): self-contained — every URL absolute (semantic rule html.absolute-urls).

media.description: §5.4: media referenced by the item; [] on an endcap (§9).

changelog.description: §5.2: one entry per version, metadata only (semantic rule changelog.contiguous).

transclusions.description: §10.3: threads always carry it, in directive order; fragments omit it; a withdrawn thread's endcap carries [].

stub_of.description: §10.6 (decision #27): threads only; lives on versions; omitted on endcaps.

forked_from.description: §5.6: reference to the pinned version this item was copied from; origin REQUIRED; immutable; survives withdrawal.

generated.description: §5.7 rule 4: omitted entirely when the version involved no generation; never on an endcap.

then.description: §9: endcap — content_md = "", content_html = "", media = [], transclusions empty if present, no stub_of, no generated.
§10.3: fragments omit transclusions entirely; §10.6: stubs are threads only.
